title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: May I make a fourth try at Tom's collar, with the zip worn about 6 cm lower so the collar's front stands open and his chin falls between its tips when he looks down?
sections.recommendation: Yes: measured this morning, his chin and jaw come through the collar's top front from 10 degrees down; a shape that pushes the collar out would have to flare it 52 mm into a funnel, and hiding skin cannot work because the skin that crosses shows above the collar. Many 1990 blousons were worn open at the neck. The other choice is to leave it as a known fault.
options: No, leave it as it is

sections.name: In the Claude app's Scheduled list, open "LEDGER: read back page answers (nightly)", press Run now and allow its page reads always; then open the session "LEDGER: fresh-session test (once)" in the sidebar and allow its question, or press Stop.
sections.recommendation: Allow: both only read. A scheduled run stops at its first question with nobody there; an answer given once is kept for its later runs, so tonight's 04:46 read-back then runs on its own. There is no web link for these; both are in the app.
